In docs/semester-2/gsos-301/unit-06/topic-02.mdx line 58, the factual claim that television and social media reach the majority of the population in Pakistan is cited as (Hammond & Cheney, n.d.). Hammond & Cheney is a US college introductory sociology text on LibreTexts and does not contain empirical findings on Pakistani media demographics. The citation should be replaced with a Pakistani empirical source (e.g. PEMRA, PBS, Gallup Pakistan) or stated as a general observation without attributing Pakistani demographics to an American textbook.

In docs/semester-2/gsos-301/unit-06/topic-01.mdx line 60, "a factory in Sialkit supplies garments to a store in Berlin" contains a typographical error in the Pakistani city name ("Sialkit" instead of "Sialkot").
